description: Sends a delivery request to the human guarantor, who can deliver the project with development and product management. Only after the user explicitly agrees: set consent to yes. Sends the summary, the timeframe, the company name and the e-mail of the account, nothing else. One request per account and day.

consent.description: yes only when the user explicitly agreed to send the request.

summary.description: What should be built and why, in plain text, without personal data or secrets.

timeframe.description: When the user needs it, in plain text.

name: request_delivery_help
title: Ask the guarantor to deliver a project
